programme.desc: Joel and Victoria Osteen's message of unconditional love and unending hope reaches everyone across the world.

programme.title: Joseph Prince
programme.desc: Joseph Prince is a leading voice in proclaiming the gospel around the world through his ministry.

programme.title: Life Today
programme.desc: A former Navy SEAL recounts his time in combat and the spiritual lessons he learned in life-and-death situations.

programme.title: Kingdom Connection With Jentezen Franklin
programme.desc: A mission to share the profound truths of God's Word; viewers are inspired by Franklin Jentezen's words, which echo the timeless wisdom of the scriptures.

programme.title: Turning Point With Dr. David Jeremiah
programme.desc: How Joseph overcame temptation.

programme.title: Touching Lives With James Merritt
programme.desc: Dr. James Merritt desires to make the name of Jesus Christ known as well as to help empower Christians in their daily walk with God; Dr. Merritt's purpose remains to bring the lost to a personal encounter with Jesus Christ.

programme.title: Takeaways With Kirk Cameron
programme.desc: Kirk Cameron is joined by former football players, Mike Flynt and Ed Tandy McGlasson, talking about their unique experiences of God giving them second chances at their dreams and calling.

programme.title: Amazing Facts With Doug Batchelor
programme.desc: Now you can understand the true identity of the two women in Revelation and better grasp the rest of Revelation through this eye-opening program.

programme.title: Gaither Gospel Hour
programme.desc: The Gaither Vocal Band performs with a host of gospel artists from all across the United States; it is headed by Bill and Gloria Gaither.

programme.title: Joyce Meyer Enjoying Everyday Life
programme.desc: Do you expect good things to happen? Today, Joyce shares how faith grows stronger when you stop focusing on fear and start trusting God.

programme.title: Turning Point With Dr. David Jeremiah
programme.desc: Dr. David Jeremiah shares the practical messages behind Christianity and helps people to discover their own turning points in their relationship with God.

programme.title: Praise
programme.desc: Sheila Walsh welcomes Robert Jeffress to explore how God works miracles today, from divine provision and protection to healing and supernatural intervention.

programme.title: Worship With The Binions and Friends
programme.desc: David and Nicole Binion host dynamic nights of worship with live music from top gospel artists.

programme.title: Travel the Road
programme.desc: Entering Ukraine, Tim Scott and Will Decker of Travel the Road set themselves to gain permission to travel to the radioactive zone of Chernobyl.

programme.title: Insights -- Israel and the Middle East
programme.desc: Israel made the desert bloom, and today it maintains a thriving agricultural industry.

programme.title: My First Trip to Israel
programme.desc: Sheila and her friend Reuven visit the Emmaus Trail in Israel, where they relive the journey of two companions who walked from Jerusalem to Emmaus after the crucifixion of Jesus; as they walk and talk, Jesus joins them, opening their eyes.

programme.title: Praise
programme.desc: Matt and Laurie Crouch host Mr. T from Los Angeles, CA.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of World War II
programme.desc: Relive the Flight of the Crow, a trek across Nazi-occupied Europe; find out how two Austrian mountaineers hiked their way out of the Himalayas, then learn why 378 Japanese POWs risked it all in Australia's bloody Cowra Breakout.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of World War II
programme.desc: Examine how German soldiers used an erotic painting and other decoys to distract their captors as they tunnelled out of Island Farm POW camp in Wales; see how American bombardiers were smuggled out of Russia, and study a wartime Trojan Horse plot.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of World War II

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of World War II
programme.desc: Discover the German submarines that caused havoc in the American desert, the playboy pilot they couldn't cage, and the young lovers whose escape defied all odds.

programme.title: Greatest Escapes of World War II

programme.title: Surviving WWII
programme.desc: Sit down with civilians who got caught in the crossfire; learn how an 11-year-old Jewish boy hid from the Nazis; meet an unjustly imprisoned Japanese-American who served his country; relive a young woman's Blitz experience.

programme.title: Surviving WWII
programme.desc: Uncover the luck and determination that helped POWs endure captivity, hunger and acts of unthinkable brutality; listen to the riveting stories of soldiers who survived infamous German stalags, Japanese forced-labour campaigns and death marches.

programme.title: Surviving WWII
programme.desc: Get insight into one of the war's most hazardous jobs, piloting aircraft; explore the constant race to provide more aerial firepower, revisit one of the war's most daring raids and hear from a glider pilot who risked it all the night before D-Day.
